About this branch

Train where Bangalore trains

FitFlix Marathahalli is one of the area's highest-rated gyms, known for its spacious, spotless training floor and supportive, professional coaching team. Located next to IRONHILL on Marathahalli's main stretch, it's built for members who want premium equipment without compromise.

Whether you're chasing strength, conditioning or a sustainable routine, our trainers bring the FitFlix standard of personalised, results-driven coaching to every session.
